project.name: My Roblox Game
project._help: Shown in every agent brief and seeded as the first game in Agent HQ. Use your game's real name.

modeling._approval_help: Used by the roblox-3d-reference skill. ask = stop after the reference brief and concept sheet and wait for the owner's yes before building any 3D model. auto = build right after the concept sheet, then show the result.
modeling._conceptTool_help: Concept sheets are made as a Claude Design artifact (Artifact tool, intent design). Never Canva.

learning._help: Things the owner teaches are saved here and loaded into every session through CLAUDE.md.
